summary: Adds a reusable skill for Excel data auditing and report generation, capturing lessons on type sanitization, column indexing, and mandatory verification steps to prevent common openpyxl/python-docx failures.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting SKILL.md to explicitly capture successful audit flag computation patterns (threshold comparisons + string status checks) and added a mandatory cross-check verification step for aggregated totals, improving reliability for future compliance auditing tasks.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting/SKILL.md to address verifier failures seen in the trace. Added explicit guidance on date type handling (datetime vs string), strict header/type matching for verifiers, explicit sort order enforcement, and reinforced modular script structure to isolate failures. These changes target common pitfalls where agent self-verification passes but strict test suites fail.

Updated the existing excel-audit-and-reporting skill to incorporate concrete lessons from the trace: explicitly warn against using generic file readers for .xlsx binaries, strengthen null/type handling guidance, emphasize mandatory reload-and-verify patterns, and clarify off-by-one indexing rules. These refinements directly address the TypeError and IndexError failures seen in the trace and will prevent future agents from repeating the same debugging loops.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting/SKILL.md to address a common openpyxl pitfall observed in the trace: auto-created default sheets causing verifier failures. Added explicit steps for loading auxiliary rule/threshold sheets into memory before row processing, and strengthened verification to check exact sheet counts. These changes generalize the successful workflow while preventing the specific dead-end encountered.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting skill to explicitly cover multi-file joins, alias normalization, and safe aggregation patterns. Added troubleshooting for the TypeError encountered during summary row accumulation, and reinforced type-casting rules before += operations.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting/SKILL.md to incorporate successful patterns from the trace: explicit template sheet preservation, composite key joins for multi-file audits, and a structured verification checklist. These additions reduce ambiguity for future agents handling similar multi-source Excel audit tasks.

Updated excel-audit-and-reporting/SKILL.md to address verifier failures observed in the trace. Added explicit guidance on pandas NaN -> openpyxl None sanitization (a top cause of stringified 'None'/'nan' verifier mismatches), environment setup for missing Python libraries in restricted containers, and stricter verifier checklist items for exact header/value matching. Preserved existing workflow structure while injecting high-signal anti-patterns and decision rules.
